scoring_justification: Result-level compare: the agent's self-reported elastic constants and derivatives are compared to the paper's experimental extrapolated values from Table 5 using absolute tolerances. Recomputing from raw process artifacts is infeasible because the agent does not produce intermediate Born model parameters.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold reference values for elastic constants and pressure derivatives (C11, C12, C44, dCij/dP, d²Cij/dP²).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Table 5 of the paper (experimental extrapolated static lattice values).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the published paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the actual experimental results reported by the paper, used as benchmark for the Born model predictions. They are not invented; they trace back to the publication.

outputs.description: Computed static lattice elastic constants and pressure derivatives; the hidden checker will compare each value to the paper's experimental extrapolated reference (Table 5) using absolute tolerances.

output_contract.notes: All values refer to zero-pressure static lattice at T=0 K. The checker uses absolute tolerances of ±10 kbar for Cij, ±0.5 for first derivatives, ±0.02 kbar⁻¹ for second derivatives.

steps.description: Compare each elastic constant field to the paper's experimental static lattice values; score is fraction of fields within tolerance.
